payload.posture: Read John 20:19–23 as one movement in the resurrection, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states jesus comes among disciples behind locked doors, speaks peace, shows wounds, sends them, breathes, and speaks of forgiveness. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the resurrection.
